items.description: El Feija National Park is a lush forest region in the Kroumirie mountains, known for its diverse flora and rare wildlife like the Barbary stag. It is a key area for nature conservation.
Boukornine National Park is a mountain range situated near the coast and the capital city, Tunis. It is appreciated for its scenic vistas and protected ecosystems.
Jebel Orbata is a mountain area in central Tunisia, characterized by its arid terrain and unique desert-adapted plant life. It is an important region for study and conservation.
The eastern section of Chott el-Jerid is a vast salt lake that transforms into a shimmering desert expanse during the summer. It is a landscape of natural beauty and geological interest.
The northern mountain range of Tunisia is a green, fertile region forming part of the Atlas Mountains system. It supports diverse agriculture and forest ecosystems.
The islands in the Gulf of Tunis are small, protected marine environments that provide essential habitats for seabirds and marine biodiversity. They are key elements of the northern coastline.
Jebel Abderrahmane is a mountain formation on the Cap Bon peninsula, providing a natural elevated landscape covered in coastal scrub and native trees.
The coastline of Mahdia is characterized by its clear waters, rocky shores, and stretches of sandy beaches. It serves as a vital habitat for diverse marine life in the region.
The region surrounding El Djem is a predominantly flat, agricultural plateau with scattered trees and vegetation. It reflects the typical landscape of the Tunisian Sahel plains.
The Gulf of Gabes is a wide coastal region known for its shallow waters and extensive sandy beaches. It is a critical ecosystem for fish breeding and coastal biodiversity.
Djebel es Sif is a prominent rocky peak in Tunisia, rising above the surrounding landscape as a distinct geological formation. It is part of the country's varied mountainous relief.
Djebel Ben Youne is a mountainous area featuring slopes and rugged terrain, contributing to the distinct relief of the region. It is a notable natural structure in the landscape.
